items.title: We Believe!
items.desc: The Aspirants cinematic trailer. Layla and Fanny meet at Selrick Academy, grow closer in training and ride out in Aspirant mecha suits to fight the Enders.

chapters.l: Title card and a dark corridor
Cold open: a spiral stairwell and an explosion
The song begins over the city at dawn
A laboratory, an alarm and a flash
A fast chase through a white corridor
A quiet field in the sun
Dusk battle over a ruined city
The fire awakens and the fight escalates
The climax: two fighters clash
Dusk after the fight, two portraits
The song credits
End card with the release dates

items.title: We Believe!, teaser
items.desc: A short teaser for the first Aspirants trailer, with the voice actress and the composer of the theme song. It was posted a few days before the trailer.

chapters.l: Cold open
Two girls lying in the grass
Sunset silhouettes
A twin-blade figure in a bright doorway
Credits on a globe display
The We Believe end card

items.title: Awakening
items.desc: On Planet Dawnbreak, androids from Planet Oro attack under Angela's lead. Ruby, who opposes the conquest, fights to awaken the android she once called her friend.

chapters.l: Prologue: ships over a burning city
The first battle in the burning city
Ruby's plea, and a memory of the lab
Back on the bridge, Ruby will not give up
Angela in the flames: I'm hurting
A large action montage and a white flash
The aftermath in the ruins
Memory and resolve: Ruby!
A corridor, soldiers and a captive
The Aspirants logo
End card: available 3 December

items.title: Rekindled Light
items.desc: The sharpshooter Lesley captures a core component from the Enders, and the first ray of hope for a counterattack is lit. The film follows Lesley and Chang'e from a warm lab memory to the night the Enders attacked.

chapters.l: Night over the ruined city
An alert in a red corridor
The bright laboratory, a memory
The attack
The aftermath
Two faces in the firelight
Resolve and a glowing ring
The turning point
The city battle
The battle climax
Calm after the battle
End card with the release date

items.title: Rekindled Light, teaser
items.desc: A teaser told in four short letters from Chang'e to Lesley, from a happy lab memory to a burning city. It ends by announcing the Rekindled Light trailer.

chapters.l: Letter one: a warm lab memory
Letter two: the city burns
Letter three: the workshop
Letter four: an explosion and a fire fight
The Aspirants title card
Announcement of the Rekindled Light trailer
End card with the release date

items.title: Lesley and Chang'e, short trailer
items.desc: A 50 second cut for the return of Chang'e Tech Tensai and Lesley Deadeye Spectre on 18 June. It runs from the lab memory through the burning city and into the game.

chapters.l: Logo and the title card, 18 June
A red corridor and a lab memory
A flashback of the burning city
The game: a skirmish with sniper shots
A cinematic burst and a vow
End card for the return of the skins
The Mobile Legends outro

items.title: Connection Lost
items.desc: Vexana, once Guinevere's most trusted partner, now fights beside the Enders. Guinevere refuses to believe that the partner she chose would betray humanity.

chapters.l: The ruined city, purple lights in the sky
Vexana enters and the long duel begins
Guinevere appeals to Vexana, with memories
A dark memory: stay with me
A dark force arrives and orders the purge
Guinevere chases Vexana through the city
Guinevere is downed, and her resolve returns
The song section and the big clash
The aftermath, and a tiny distant figure
End card: Aspirants Unite, 3 October

items.title: Day of Enders
items.desc: The crisis in the Singularity is far from over. Obsidia, the mastermind behind the Enders, quietly reveals herself while the Aspirants fight with all their might, and Selena watches from a rooftop in her school uniform.

chapters.l: A dark throne hall
Selena on the rooftop, a red portal opens
The city invasion
The Aspirants' last stand
A quiet talk in a dark chamber
The duel: I'll never be your puppet again
The cat companions watch the city
A song over the fight
A cosmic confrontation
A winged form unfolds in space
End card: available 9 October
The M Label logo

items.title: Ruby
items.desc: Ruby tells her own story: the heir of Planet Oro, the council that rules her life, and the android Angela she builds as a way out. The plan turns into a friendship she did not expect.

chapters.l: Ruby speaks in the council hall
She introduces the android Angela
Training and the secret lab
The council and the android troops
Ruby plans the trojan in Angela
Memories of Angela and Ruby
A flash and a pink transition
Epilogue
End card

items.title: Angela
items.desc: Angela tells it from her side: the lab where Ruby made her, the Gardens, the daily training, and the word hurt, which she does not yet understand.

chapters.l: Angela's voice over a ship in space
The name Ruby on a card
The training field
Injury and care in the lab
The mission and the android units
A dark pause
A blurred close-up in motion

items.title: Selena
items.desc: Selena is a student at Selrick Academy who cannot stand early mornings, the sun in her eyes or taking orders. She says she is no one's doll.

chapters.l: A playful opening
Selena at her desk in the design studio
A sketch becomes an armored form
A dark, rebellious sequence
A light school-life flashback
Panels and a mirror portrait
A red flash into the end card

items.title: Obsidia
items.desc: Obsidia calls herself the Will that ends civilizations. She says she does not destroy, she purges the parasites from the host, and a chained Selena appears before her.

chapters.l: A singularity opens on Obsidia
Planets bound by strings: I am its Will
The Ender army and the mothership
The aftermath, with blue butterflies
A chained Selena: still believe you have a choice?
Free will is a flaw that must be corrected
A red flash into the end card

items.title: Layla and Fanny, short animation
items.desc: A light short about Layla and Fanny in freeform training at Selrick Academy. Layla is sure she will beat Fanny this time.

items.title: Re:Link
items.desc: Vexana is ready to sacrifice herself to destroy the Mother Matrix, but she cannot watch Guinevere fall. She blocks an attack meant for Guinevere and gives herself away, and Guinevere then stands in front of her.

chapters.l: A title card
Vexana stands alone in the ruined city
Vexana is thrown down
Guinevere appears beside her
A memory and a vow
The finale against a vast winged entity
End card

items.title: Guinevere and Vexana, comic film
items.desc: The Guinevere and Vexana comic as a motion comic with sound, in Japanese. It opens on Vexana kneeling in rubble and goes back three hours to show how she got there.

chapters.l: Vexana kneeling in the rubble
Three hours earlier, in the corridor
Falling through darkness, warm memories
Teacher Chang'e's mission
Vexana's dark turn
The armored transformation and the alarm
A night flight over the city
End card: Aspirants Unite
